ai_overview_references.title: We scanned 399 local businesses. 7% got named. - Seenvia

answer_text:
In published September 2026 research by Seenvia, Perplexity cited 81 distinct hosts (unique web domains/hosts) across local business recommendation answers.
Would you like to know more about which types of third-party directories or websites dominated those citations, or how to improve a local business's visibility on Perplexity?
